Update: Nov 18th, 2026 15:38 EST 0 Share facebook twitter whatsapp Make us preferred on Google According to the agency’s payment schedule , the Social Security Administration (SSA) now has just one distribution date remaining in November 2026 , as it sends out benefits for the following U.S. programs:
 Social Security (retirement, disability and survivor) 
 Supplemental Security Income (SSI) 
 Who is still to be paid for November?
 Of the 71.7 million people who receive Social Security benefits in the U.S., many are paid on the second, third or fourth Wednesday in each month . These recipients’ designated Wednesday depends on their date of birth.
 After today’s payment run, for beneficiaries born from the 11th to 20th of any month, this three-Wednesdays cycle is due to conclude next week . On November 25, Social Security is to be issued to recipients born between the 21st and 31st of each month.
 Earlier this month, November’s birthday-dependent payment schedule kicked off with a calendar quirk . Because the month’s second Wednesday fell on Veterans Day , payment for beneficiaries born between the first and 10th of the month was brought forward by 24 hours.
 At a glance - November 2026’s three-Wednesdays cycle: 
 Born on 1st-10th of month: Social Security paid out on Tuesday, Nov. 10 
 Born on 11th-20th of month: Social Security paid out on Wednesday, Nov. 18 
 Born on 21st-31st of month: Social Security paid out on Wednesday, Nov. 25 
 NB: If you receive Social Security benefits based on someone else’s employment history, the SSA uses the other person’s date of birth to determine your payment Wednesday.
 What other payment dates are there in Nov. 2026?
 Before November’s three-Wednesdays cycle began, three groups of SSA benefits recipients were paid on distribution dates that were not birthday-dependent .
 Oct. 30: SSI beneficiaries 
 Recipients of SSI benefits were paid for November just before the month began: on Friday, October 30 . 
 A benefit for low-income, low-resource Americans who are over the age of 65 or have a disability, SSI is normally issued on the first day of each month. However, this month’s money was distributed slightly ahead of schedule , as November began on a Sunday .
 A scheme with around 7.3 million beneficiaries, SSI provides a maximum federal benefit of $994 a month for individual claimants. ( Some states also pay a monthly supplement to program beneficiaries.)
 Although SSI is run by the SSA, it is separate to the Social Security program . Unlike Social Security, eligibility is not dependent on an applicant’s work record.
 Nov. 3: Dual beneficiaries/certain long-term Social Security recipients 
 On Tuesday 3 , the SSA issued November’s Social Security benefits to recipients who have been claiming their monthly payments since before May 1997 . 
 November 3 was also this month’s Social Security payment date for recipients who are simultaneously signed up to SSI .
 How much are monthly Social Security benefits?
 Retirement: $2,037.84 
 Disability: $1,500.84 
 Survivor: $1,636.75 
 ( Average monthly Social Security benefit , per stats published by the SSA in Nov. 2026.)
 COLA brings 2027 benefits increase
 In October, the SSA announced that Social Security and SSI benefits are to go up in 2027 , as part of the agency’s annual cost-of-living adjustment (COLA). Starting with January’s payments, beneficiaries are to receive a 3.6% increase in their monthly amounts.
 How does the Social Security Admin pay benefits?
 Benefits can be paid into a Social Security or SSI beneficiary’s bank account by direct deposit 
 Money can be loaded onto the Direct Express Card , a special debit card for federal disbursements
